title: 廢塑膠清洗造粒
titleEn: Washing and pelletizing of waste plastics
summary: 以「聚合物辨識、清洗收支與熔融造粒品質」為主線，依序完成十個專題單元。學徒在場景中辨識設備、列出邊界、重算明示的教學算例、比較量測與模型，最後診斷故障並交付證據。每一單元保留機制、算例、驗證與失效四種學習任務。
summaryEn: Follow polymer identification, washing balances and pellet quality through ten technical units. Identify equipment in the scene, define boundaries, reproduce explicitly hypothetical examples, compare measurements with models, and diagnose faults before handing over evidence. Each unit contains mechanism, calculation, verification and failure tasks.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.instruction: 先辨識目標聚合物與標籤、金屬、其他樹脂，再將採樣組成換算為產線負荷；混合樹脂可能互不相容。
steps.instructionEn: Identify the target polymer, labels, metals and other resins before converting sampled composition into line loads; mixed resins can be incompatible.

steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: target mass=feed*target fraction;1000*0.75; calculation 1000*0.75 = 750 kg. Applicability: Representative composite sample; hypothetical dry feed.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「廢塑膠清洗造粒」的「進料聚合物收支：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出污染或資源來源、處理單元、回收與排放的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「資源循環物料站」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與配對採樣位置、濃度、流量、時間與品質旗標的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Feed polymer balance: Mechanism and observation” in “Washing and pelletizing of waste plastics”. Draw the source, treatment, recovery and discharge boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Circular-resource material station” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for paired sampling locations, concentrations, flows, times and quality flags, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.instruction: 破碎須把標籤及附著物解離，過度破碎則增加細粉、清洗損失與能耗。
steps.instructionEn: Shredding liberates labels and attachments, while excessive reduction creates fines, washing loss and energy demand.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：fines fraction=mass below screen/feed;35/1000；計算 35/1000 = 0.035 fraction。適用限制：相同乾燥條件下的篩分質量。

steps.failure: 只降低平均粒徑可能把可回收樹脂送進污泥。
steps.failureEn: Reducing mean size alone can send recoverable resin into sludge.
steps.check: 比較刀具間隙改變前後的細粉量與未解離率。
steps.checkEn: Compare fines and unliberated attachments before/after a cutter-gap change.

操作任務：在「解離與粒徑分布」的教學模型或試算表中先重現 0.035 fraction，再依驗證任務改動一個輸入、保留其餘條件。對照「只降低平均粒徑可能把可回收樹脂送進污泥。」的異常情境，提交基準與變更後數值、單位及一項能區分兩者的量測。
steps.instructionEn:
Compare fines and unliberated attachments before/after a cutter-gap change.
Action: In the teaching model or spreadsheet for liberation and particle size, first reproduce 0.035 fraction, then vary one input following the verification task while holding other conditions fixed. Contrast the fault scenario "Reducing mean size alone can send recoverable resin into sludge." and submit baseline and changed values, units, and one measurement that distinguishes them.
steps.observation: 原創假想教學算例：fines fraction=mass below screen/feed;35/1000；計算 35/1000 = 0.035 fraction。適用限制：相同乾燥條件下的篩分質量。
steps.observationEn: Original hypothetical teaching example: fines fraction=mass below screen/feed;35/1000; calculation 35/1000 = 0.035 fraction. Applicability: Sieve masses on the same dry basis.
